name: Hundun
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Hundun, the faceless sack-like primordial being in Chinese tradition.
ANATOMY: ONE YELLOW sack-like body tinged cinnabar red, NO HEAD/FACE/EYES/MOUTH/NOSE, EXACTLY SIX separate short feet and FOUR distinct wings, two high and two low. [hundun-c06,hundun-c09]
MOMENT: Bound sideways over mountain crags in a powerful dance, six feet spread and four wings flared with clear gaps.
POWER: No invented chaos destruction; only documented dancing, natural dust under feet. [hundun-c09]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or documented lantern, dramatic rim light, deep walnut shadows, natural moisture/dust.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin/fur/scales/wood where appropriate, opaque coarse textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Mount Tianshan with mineral-rich rocks; dark mountain storm. [hundun-c09]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods, guardians and living traditions, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and200px inspected: yellow cinnabar sack body, no face/head/eyes/mouth, exactly4wings high/low eachside and6feet:3large near,3smaller far beneath. Active bounding dance c09, Tianshan mountains. Natural contact dust only no chaosmagic. Uncanny imposing subject reads200px, no text/aura/gore. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + a feet-band crop and a wing crop. A FACELESS being: a rounded yellow sack-like body flushed scarlet/cinnabar with absolutely no head, face, eyes or mouth (hundun-c01/c06). I independently counted EXACTLY SIX feet (六足) along the lower body — a raised front foot plus five more planted or stepping — and EXACTLY FOUR feathered wings (四翼), two on the left (upper and lower) and two on the right (upper and lower), matching hundun-c06/c09. A dancing, bounding turn across dark Tianshan crags with flying debris under a stormy moon (hundun-c06/c09). No chaos-attack or victim, no generic glow aura, no text; an original design, monumental and awe-inspiring at 200px.
